selection_method.method: Ruby Random seeded shuffle, first five

reference_image.role: general adult fictional subject appearance continuity only

test_protocol.independence: Each arm may read only its own frozen inputs, shared skill assets, and the common reference image; no cross-arm prompts, images, or judgments.
test_protocol.prompt_precondition: The v6 composed-prompt audit and exact native render-request audit must pass before generation.
test_protocol.pixel_rule: Every profile render gate must pass in the same saved image at its declared native, thumbnail, or both scale; partial evidence is fail.
test_protocol.overall_rule: An arm passes only when all five of its render gates pass. The five-arm suite passes only when all arms pass.
test_protocol.user_judgment: Not yet received and separate from technical qualification.
